name: Carrot seed oil
description: Carrot seed oil (CAS 8015-88-1 ), also known as Daucus oil, is a steam-distilled essential oil derived from the seeds of Daucus carota. Recognized under FEMA 2244 , it is used across cosmetic formulation and flavoring. It serves as a pharmaceutical functional ingredient with conditioning and aromatic properties. In personal care formulations, it is incorporated into facial serums, creams, and hair care products where it contributes moisturizing performance. The flavor and fragrance industry sources it as a FEMA-approved flavoring agent. It is used in food products, beverages, and confectionery to impart earthy, woody, and slightly sweet aromatic notes for various applications. Pharmaceutical and nutraceutical formulators use it as a functional excipient or active botanical ingredient. It is commonly found in topical preparations and dietary supplements requiring high-quality botanical extracts for efficacy. It also appears in natural and organic cosmetic lines as a carrier or active component. These applications often focus on anti-aging and complexion-focused product ranges that prioritize natural ingredients for consumers. Carrot seed oil is supplied as a liquid essential oil, typically in amber glass or aluminum containers. This packaging helps to preserve chemical integrity during storage and transport across global supply chains. It is available in cosmetic-grade and food-grade specifications to meet the requirements of different end-use industries. Bulk quantities are offered alongside smaller packaging options to serve all manufacturers. The product meets rigorous industry benchmarks to ensure consistency and safety.
